environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding traffic directly to port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and ALB forwards to target group on port 8080. No additional request inspection or filtering is configured on the ALB beyond default health checks. The Flask application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.11, SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db containing production user records.

config.network: Public ALB -> target group port 8080, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
